source.retrieval: Reuses the same-day original captured and independently checked for Armor-Piercing Rounds; not a new fetch.

primary_context.fact: Official fix for enhanced Ricochet Rounds stat benefit; does not specify maximum bounces or reflection/self-damage geometry.
Historical Hard Light ricochet bonus differs by mode. Engine exposes bounce counts; this batch does not adopt historical damage multipliers.

implemented_mechanism: Instantaneous piecewise-linear path with shared total range, face reflection, explicit maximum additional entities and bounces, a configurable per-target contact count, opt-in origin contact after a bounce, one frozen observation and ordered world writes.
unverified_content_policies: All readable COLLIDER block shapes reflect specularly; fluids do not. No D2 material-specific surface catalogue or angle/randomness calibration is claimed.
Maximum bounces is required as an explicit content value. The source only guarantees ricochets and does not establish a universal count or infinite bouncing.

The default excludes owner and emitter; hit_origin_after_bounce can include both after an actual surface reflection. This is capability and policy, not a calibrated D2 self-damage coefficient or proc-eligibility claim.

The default allows one contact per target. hits_per_target can allow later reflected segments to hit the same target again; each segment observes at most one contact per target. Actual D2 repeated-hit qualification and target-instance generation handling remain uncalibrated.
Range consumes cumulative segment length. Whether every D2 archetype applies its damage falloff and ricochet modifiers identically remains unverified.
Ricochet Rounds Range/Stability values and Seraph Range/Stability/flinch full content assembly are not supplied by this engine-only change.
